name: Idea-ology Ephemera Pack, Snippets
descriptionOriginal: A pack of die-cut paper ephemera in a vintage style: labels, typography, tickets and frames, made for layering.
whyWeLikeIt: Ready-made aged paper bits give a page a travelled, collected look straight away. Ranger describes this pack as sized for journals, cards, tags and albums.
limitations: The look is aged and vintage, not soft or modern. These are printed pieces, not found paper, so they work best alongside your own scraps.
qualityNote: Customers say it is good quality and versatile for paper projects. Concern: the look is aged and vintage, not a soft floral.
specsEvidence: Ranger Ink, https://rangerink.com/products/tim-holtz-idea-ology-ephemera-pack-snippets (read 2026-11-20): 'vintage-inspired' assortment featuring vintage florals, labels, typography, tickets, frames and decorative accents, sized for journals, cards, tags, albums, planners and mixed media. suitability: Vintage-style die-cut paper ephemera for layering into the pages of a first junk journal.
